name: router
description: Model and effort routing for the main conversation by task difficulty and activity, advised by a prompt classifier (Jev, Clef, Clef Flash, OpenAI or local Ollama). Subagents get one model at spawn: every agent that does not pin one.

typesafe_api_key.title: Jev API key (typesafe.ai)
typesafe_api_key.description: Jev API key from typesafe.ai. Used when the classifier is Jev; without its key the current model is kept.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token (Clef, Clef Flash)
cloudflare_api_token.description: Workers AI token for the Clef and Clef Flash classifiers. Scope it to Workers AI only.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID (Clef, Clef Flash)
cloudflare_account_id.description: The Cloudflare account that runs Workers AI. Not a secret.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (OpenAI classifier)
openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key for the gpt-6-luna classifier. Used only when the classifier is OpenAI; the bounded prompt text then goes to OpenAI. Ollama needs no key.
